E Leshun's death, 'less than a year after E Chang's' (s0105), is therefore AD 1755–1756 (external).

The emperor (上) who ordered Wang Guodong out at the autumn assize is either the Yongzheng or the Qianlong Emperor; the chapter does not establish which, so he is a separate, unidentified person row.
E Chang's and E Leshun's fathers are unnamed brothers of Ortai entailed by 從子; they may be the same man, which the chapter does not establish. Both carry research holds.

五日京兆 alludes to the Han official Zhang Chang; it is an idiom, not a reference to a person in this chapter, so no person row is made.
